novel_features.name: dial
novel_features.description: Ergonomic outbound Vapi assistant calls with dry-run/yes guardrails, batch destinations, scheduling, and recording enabled by default.

novel_features.name: juno
novel_features.description: Cathryn's personal house-manager workflows for delegated calls, reservations, ordering, vendor quotes, follow-ups, and call status/recording review.

novel_features.name: juno followup
novel_features.description: Re-call or leave a message using the same assistant, destination, and Juno task variables from a previous call.

novel_features.name: juno status
novel_features.description: Poll call outcome, summarize status/transcript/cost, and download Vapi call recordings from the existing recording endpoints.

novel_features.name: record-by-default
novel_features.description: Private outbound dial and Juno calls inject assistantOverrides.artifactPlan recording settings unless --no-record is passed.

novel_features.name: juno setup
novel_features.description: Verify Juno assistant and phone-number readiness, then save assistant-id and phone-number-id into a reusable local profile.

novel_features.name: juno test-call
novel_features.description: Guarded recorded smoke-test call workflow that can dry-run the payload, place a live call with --yes, watch for completion, and download the recording.

novel_features.name: juno report
novel_features.description: Summarize recent or explicit Juno call IDs with status, summary, duration, cost, transcript, and recording hints.

novel_features.name: juno phone-numbers
novel_features.description: List Vapi phone numbers with focused outbound readiness hints for Juno setup.

novel_features.name: juno assistant
novel_features.description: Preview, create, or update the default Juno assistant prompt and artifact settings without hand-building assistant JSON.
